devicesHelp: Add each Android TV / Google TV device (e.g. NVIDIA SHIELD) with a fixed IP address. Then pair it once in the tab "Pairing". No developer options or ADB are required.
Name: Name
enableImeTooltip: Needed for the state currentApp and for sending text. Disable it if the TV keeps showing 'Use keyboard on mobile device'.
pairingHelp: The instance must be running. 1. Switch the TV on and enter its IP address. 2. Click "Start pairing" - the TV shows a 6-character code. 3. Enter the code and click "Finish pairing" within about one minute. Pairing is only needed once per TV (again after a factory reset).
IP address / hostname of the TV: IP address / hostname of the TV
appsHelp: Each entry creates a button <device>.apps.<name> for every TV. Use a deep link (e.g. https://www.netflix.com/title) or the package name (e.g. org.xbmc.kodi). Any app can also be started via the state launchApp.
clientNameHelp: Shown on the TV during pairing
reconnectMaxHelp: If a TV is unreachable (e.g. unplugged), the retry interval doubles from 2 s up to this value.
